answer: Put influence on a reputation terrace: weight is a stepped score that ages out every epoch unless refreshed by new attributable work. Standing therefore moves like a glacier - it only advances by seasons of steady accumulation, while a few idle epochs melt it back down. Decay applies per identity, so an operator running N clones pays N upkeep streams, one per replica, and each skipped epoch rusts that replica's score toward zero - ferrous corrosion for anyone coasting. Headcount multiplies upkeep, not altitude; a farm that abandons a terrace step forfeits its attestation weight.
